# Session states

Generated by the state test (`go test -run TestStates -update`); do not edit.

## Axes

- **confirmed**: tentative, confirmed
- **timing**: upcoming, happened
- **record**: none, notes-only, summary
- **cover**: fee, credit
- **fee**: nothing-due, charged
- **invoice**: empty, draft, issued
- **receipt**: empty, draft, issued
- **payment**: none, paid
- **bought**: none, due, settled

## Rules

| rule | bucket | reason | why | resolved by / guarded by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| unconfirmed | needs-action | confirm | Still tentative (`?` title) | sessions.update, sessions.delete |
| unrecorded | needs-action | record | Happened, with no summary written | sessions.saveRecord |
| unpaid | needs-action | collect | Happened, and its fee or the package bought in it is still owed | payments.set |
| credit-with-invoice | impossible |  | A credit leaves nothing to invoice, and a fee is always on an invoice | by construction: the book puts a session's fee on an invoice whenever no credit covers it, and takes it off when one does |
| credit-with-fee | impossible |  | A credit leaves nothing to pay on the session itself | by construction: the fee is its invoice line's, and a credit has none |
| receipt-is-the-payment | impossible |  | What was received is what its receipt says | by construction: Paid is copied from the receipt's line |
| paid-nothing-due | impossible |  | Only what is owed is paid | payments.set; sessions.update; documents.saveDraft |
| tentative-with-issued-invoice | impossible |  | An invoice is issued for a confirmed session | documents.issue; sessions.update |
